info.title: Paperwork.CLI
info.description: Paperwork CLI — generate PDFs from the command line using the Paperwork / Scryber engine.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Paperwork — generate dynamic PDF reports from the command line.

options.name: --template
options.description: Paperwork template ID to fetch from Firebase Storage.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Firebase environment: production (default), staging, or dev.

options.name: --personal
options.description: Fetch a personal-scope template (--template must be the full '{owner}:{slug}' id). Requires 'paperwork login' first.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a TemplateConfigV1 JSON file.

options.name: --layout
options.description: Path to an HTML layout file.

options.name: --style
options.description: CSS file to include. Repeat for multiple files.

options.name: --data
options.description: Data binding in the form name=path.json. Repeat for multiple sources.

options.name: --field
options.description: Field override in the form key=value. Repeat for multiple values.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output PDF path. Omit to write PDF bytes to stdout.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a TemplateConfigV1 JSON config file.

arguments.name: CONFIG
arguments.description: Path to the TemplateConfigV1 JSON file to validate.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign in so 'generate --personal' can fetch your personal templates.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Sign-in provider: github (default). microsoft and google are not yet supported.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Firebase environment: production (default), staging, or dev.
